records.content: dbo.Products(ProductId int primary key, CategoryId int foreign key references dbo.Categories(CategoryId), Name nvarchar(100)).
dbo.Categories(CategoryId int primary key, Name nvarchar(100)). Join Products.CategoryId = Categories.CategoryId.
Question: count products per category. SQL: SELECT TOP (1000) c.Name, COUNT(*) AS ProductCount FROM dbo.Categories AS c JOIN dbo.Products AS p ON p.CategoryId=c.CategoryId GROUP BY c.Name.
